interpretation: A pass means retained signing-readiness evidence records Team ID, provisioning profile UUID, unique bundle ID, non-ad-hoc codesign identity, registered physical-device UDID hashes, and signed-app entitlements for an iPhoneOS artifact. It is not an install, launch, VideoToolbox, input, reconnect, audio, or full iOS device-acceptance pass.
missing: xcode.version: must be a non-empty recorded value
xcode.selected_developer_dir: must be a non-empty recorded value
xcode.ios_sdk: must be a non-empty recorded value
signing.team_id: must be a non-empty recorded value
signing.provisioning_profile_uuid: must be a non-empty recorded value
signing.bundle_id: must be a non-empty recorded value
signing.codesign_identity: must be a non-empty recorded value
signing.signed_artifact_sha256: must be a non-empty recorded value
signing.signed_artifact_sha256: must be a SHA-256 digest
signing.device_udids: must include at least one registered physical-device UDID hash
signing.entitlements.application_identifier: must be a non-empty recorded value
signing.entitlements.team_identifier: must be a non-empty recorded value
signing.entitlements.bundle_identifier: must be a non-empty recorded value
signing.entitlements.keychain_access_groups: must list at least one group
signing.entitlements.raw_entitlements_sha256: must be a non-empty recorded value
artifacts: must include retained signing command/profile/entitlements output

owner.scope: Phase 5 iOS app-signing readiness prerequisite only
